date.as_written: samvata sāla 60 pradovisā || pusā māsa saṃpurṇa bhayā
date.tithi: pradovisā (uncertain; probably praviṣṭa/solar day, not a lunar tithi)

notes: The colophon names no human persons: no scribe, owner, commissioner or king. The date formula is in Nepali ('samvata sāla 60 ... pusā māsa saṃpurṇa bhayā' = 'completed in the month of Pauṣa, year [..]60'). The year '60' is probably an abbreviated year with the century left out. Nepali 'sāla' dating suggests Vikrama Saṃvat (e.g. VS 1960 = c. 1903 CE), but this cannot be confirmed, so the era is left unspecified and ce_approx is left empty. 'pradovisā' is obscure. It may be 'pra[viṣṭa]' (the solar day count used in Nepali dates) followed by a corrupt day numeral, possibly a misreading of 'bāisa' (22); this is uncertain. The final invocation is corrupt ('brahmaṇe(!)devāya ... sāyāhya' for sāyujya) and has no prosopographical content.
